estimator: Weighted Aalen-Johansen product-integral: for each distinct normalized duration, riskweight of every observation still at risk, causeweight for TP/stop/expiry; jointly remove all terminal events after adding their incidence using prior survival. Same-duration censor remains at risk for that event group; no random jitter. Price-only mean logreturn is sum of event-mass times its realized net logreturn. Unidentified remaining mass retained; point and all bootstrap replicates must have mass<=1e-10 and positive totalweight, otherwiseCASH. Administrative censoring may still correlate with calendar regime; conditional noninformative censoring is an unproven modeling assumption, not a guarantee.
uncertainty: 199 circular10parent-date block bootstrap replicates, same multiplicities for both ETFs, original kernelweights fixed at current query. Seed828+ETdateordinal. Common margin=max(0,90thpercentile_higher of max acrossETF bootstrap-point deviation). Point-minus-margin must be positive. This estimates local weighted-sample sensitivity, not full base-model uncertainty, a formal confidence bound, simultaneous control across4dailychecks, or a guarantee of nonnegative months.
